correctness.rationale: The final claim has n>=5, char(k)=2 and f in Lambda^3 V, f!=0, A_1(f)!=0, with zero included only in Z_n. Splitting V=kv direct-sum W gives f=v wedge omega, and any second independent degree-one annihilator forces a decomposable f; alternating canonical form makes s unique and A_1(f) dimension 3 for s=1, 1 for s>=2. Each cubic wedge map has exactly the rank of multiplication by omega on Lambda W in the same source degree. In characteristic two omega^2=0. The tensor decomposition into s two-generator complexes yields homology (2t)^s(1+t)^(n-1-2s), and (1+t)^(n-1)=H(t)+(1+t^2)R(t), proving the entire graded rank quotient. Evaluating at t=1 gives 2^(n-2)-2^(n-s-2). Finite-field strata count unique lines and alternating rank-2s quotient forms; the incidence total space over P(V) has rank binom(n-1,2), is irreducible and proper over the closed divisibility image, and rank-s orbit bundles are smooth of stated dimension. The n=6 annihilator-free rank 14 follows from degree-1 and degree-2 duality. Independent GF(2) brute-force enumerations of all 1024 n=5 and 1,048,576 n=6 cubic elements returned n=5 map-rank histogram {0:1,2:155,4:868} and n=6 {0:1,3:1395,5:54684,6:992496}; independent actual multiplication maps matched every canonical profile for n=5..9 and all s, 14 cases. Finite tests corroborate rather than prove general fields/dimensions.
